questions.q: What codename did Jean Grey use when she debuted in 1963?
questions.why: Marvel Girl was Jean's debut codename, first seen in The X-Men #1.

questions.q: Which entity gave Jean a new body after her shuttle sacrifice?
questions.why: The Phoenix Force created a new body after she died piloting a damaged shuttle.

questions.q: Jean Grey married which X-Men leader in X-Men vol. 2 #30 (1994)?
questions.why: X-Men volume 2 #30 (March 1994) is where Jean and Cyclops wed.

questions.q: Which power did Jean start out with at debut, before telepathy was added?
questions.why: She started with telekinesis only; telepathy was added later.

questions.q: Which creative duo made the 1980 storyline in Uncanny X-Men #129-138?
questions.why: Claremont wrote and Byrne illustrated the Dark Phoenix Saga.

questions.q: Which secret society manipulates Jean into becoming her dark alter ego?
questions.why: The Hellfire Club's manipulation turns Phoenix into Dark Phoenix.

questions.q: Alongside Sophie Turner, which actress played Jean Grey in the 2000-2019 X-Men film series?
questions.why: Famke Janssen and Sophie Turner both played Jean in the film series.

questions.q: Which Marvel editor-in-chief demanded the 1980 saga's ending be rewritten in issue #137?
questions.why: Jim Shooter felt Jean living was morally unacceptable, forcing a rewrite.

questions.q: Which villain created Madelyne Pryor, the clone of Jean who married Scott Summers?
New X-Men #150, the cover-dated issue in which Jean dies, carries which year?
questions.why: Jean's second death comes in New X-Men #150, dated February 2004.
